title: YouCam API Skin AI & eCommerce VTO Hackathon
summary: Build a working beauty, skincare or shopping application using at least one YouCam API.
eligibility: Legal adults; Indian students can use the India-specific API signup route. Other country exclusions apply.

prize.description: US$6,000 cash pool including a US$1,000 student award; one prize per project.

notes: Source repository, functioning API integration and a 1–3 minute video are required.
1,000 free API units can be requested.
